text: Over the last 21 hours, BAM share fell 0.12 percentage points, though it is still up 0.15 percentage points over 7 days to 37.6%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 26.9% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Leadership changes remain whale-driven routing, not evidence of structural rollover; only the fra rollover on 2026-06-24 has been validated.
